Current milestone state — updated 2026-11-24.

VERSION: v1.3.0 stable (2026-07-23) still current — the installed rvr is 1.3.0, so bootstraps stay pre-#191 (persisted, read back from a file) until v1.4.0 ships. Unreleased on main: #190, #191, action bumps #199/#200/#201/#214, bun batch #217, #218 (#211), #219 (#207), #220, #221, #222 and the docs refresh (#223 + 53e52ab). As of 2026-11-24 there are no open PRs and no branch but main. UNTIL 1.4.0 IS INSTALLED: `rvr set k <<EOF` and `rvr set k < file` fail on the installed 1.3.0 ("No input received from stdin", fixed by #221) — pipe the value or pass "$(cat file)".

THEME: v1.4.0 = FORUM (#186, picked 2026-09-04). Milestone 'v1.4.0 — Find' (#13 #43 #47) still exists alongside 'v1.4.0 — Forum' — retire it: the release checklist's milestone gate matches the version prefix and prints both. SCOPE (owner decision 2026-11-24): #189 and #186 ARE v1.4.0 release items. A cut proposed earlier the same day — front page only, #189 and steps 3–4 to the next minor — was REVERSED; do not re-propose it. DONE: #187, #188 (#191), #211 (#218: one shared gist width 80/40/keys-only before any drop), #207 (#219: Claude Code's session id adopted when RVR_SESSION is unset — [[context.sessionDetection]]), #220 (context.next_session exempt from the write-amp guard, the one exempt key), #221 (no issue: `set` reads a value from a heredoc, here-string or `< file`; only pipes worked before), #215 step 1 (#222: an unparseable store file is a STORE_UNREADABLE error, never an absence — [[context.unreadableStoreFiles]]; #215 stays open, steps 2–3 remain). NEXT, in order: (a) #216 (case-only key overwrite) — edits directoryStore.ts, start from fresh main; (b) #189 replies — needs a design pass first (on-disk layout, get --json shape, reply identity = committer, not agent), then the rest of #215, which depends on it. OPEN FOR THE OWNER: (1) #186 steps 3–4 (open questions via #140, compaction via #84) have no issues under the milestone — confirm whether closing #186 in v1.4.0 includes them; (2) `set` silently replaces a subtree, no issue filed — [[context.setReplacesSubtree]]; (3) left out of #222: a value-less `rvr set <key> --confirm` waits forever on an open non-terminal stdin (same on 1.3.0; needs a stdin-semantics decision in #221's code).

RELEASE CHECKLIST v1.4.0: bump package.json 1.3.0 → 1.4.0 and CHANGELOG [Unreleased]; /security-audit; exercise the MCP surface deliberately (#191 and #218 changed both, MCP gets no ambient use); compiled-binary validation per [[context.bunCompileGotchas]]; stale-tag comm check per [[context.releaseTagNamespace]]; watch the release workflow (first run of the action bumps). Optional riders that distort soak stats: #192, #204. #213 stays open — #191 only remaps the two legacy defaults; the owner's Mac holds a hand-set bootstrap_max_response_bytes of 140000 that the remap skips — lower or unset it after installing 1.4.0, then read a week of context rows (pinned/indexed/demotedNamespaces) to calibrate the pinned default. #186's checklist is unticked for #187/#188 and does not list #215.

UNEXERCISED UNTIL THE NEXT TAG: the release.yml bumps (#200 upload-artifact 7.0.2, #201 download-artifact 8.0.2, #214 action-gh-release 3.0.4) — SHAs checked against upstream tags, never run. #191 went in on 1549 tests + CodeQL, no code review. Dependency handling: [[context.dependabotOverrides]].

EXTERNAL DATASET 2026-10-30 → issues #202–#213, see [[context.channelFit]]. Overlaps with prior filings: D2=#192, D4⊂#137 (#207 is the cheap partial), D7=#190.

SOAK: the v1.3.0 soak (clock 2026-07-23) hit the 14d cap without an eval; the Sept theme pick superseded it. Next soak pegs to v1.4.0.

OPEN FOLLOW-UP (since July): GHSAs for #158/#159 still unfiled — only GHSA-hf25 exists; scoping in [[context.ghsaExecOnRead]].

CARRIED CANDIDATES: #137 session derivation, #136 retrospective, #139 audit value controls, #140 miss-paths, #84 entry health, #42 git-freshness, #45 attribution.

RELEASE MAP: v1.4.0 Forum (#186) / v1.5.0 Reach (#6 #49) / v1.6.0 Share (#115) / v1.7.0 Scale (#44 #48 #143) / v1.8.0 Surfaces (#51) / v2.0.0 (#128, Sept 2027).

TIER-3 REFACTOR BACKLOG: import-pipeline unification, rename/copy core, paths.ts walk dedup, registerTool migration, load() snapshot memo. NON-ENGINEERING: [[project.commercialContext]], launch comms, visual identity.
